newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stocks bullish, Unibanka hits new record. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Latvian stocks bullish, Unibanka hits new record. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]

text.p: Latvian stocks ended a buoyant week with a small fall (corrects from "large gain") in turnover on Friday and Unibanka hit its fifth consecutive record high and was expected to advance further, dealers said.
Total market turnover came to 235,000 lats and commercial bank indices registered new highs after peaking at the end of January.
The Rietumu Bank market index grew 3.21 percent to 169.84. The Saules Bank index Saule10, which tracks the bourse's 10 most active listings hit 172.28, up 3.33 percent.
Market leader Unibanka 3.91 lats, jumping 30 santimes.
It also showed the biggest turnover, at 72,000 lats.
"Unibanka's climb is natural and not speculative. Investors are interested in this stable enterprise and the price may grow further," Saules Bank equities chief Karlis Krastinsh said.
A meeting of Unibanka share holders is also scheduled for March 25 and audited profit figures for 1996 are expected to be released ahead of the meeting.
On the secondary list, Daugavpils Chain maker slipped 15 percent to 2.61 lats on turnover of 61,000 lats.
Other official list shares were also active but way behind both turnover leaders.
Riga Transport Fleet traded 14,000 lats and remained stable at 1.70 lats while the Staburadze confectionery firm closed five santimes up at 2.65 on trade of 10,100 lats.
Elsewhere on the secondary market, fish canneries were among the most active.
Kaija turned over 13,800 lats and Roja was slightly lower at 13,200 lats. Kaija added three santimes to 2.23 and Roja edged up one santime to 3.00 lats.
Mangali Shipyard and Jelgava Construction company were among the day's big gainers, adding some 14 percent.
Jelgava turned over 5,700 lats and closed at 48 santimes and Mangali ended up at 1.33 lats against 1.16.
Lode Brick factory closed higher at 2.11 lats versus 2.07 on turnover of 8,700 lats.
Salacgriva95 fish cannery slipped 10 percent to 2.61 lats on volume of 5,000 lats.
